info.title: Project Brief Agent API
info.description: Project Brief v0.9.10. Legacy individual agent credentials remain compatible. Shared agent credentials require an explicit linked X-ProjectBrief-Agent-ID on every request. Effective access is the intersection of credential scopes, owner grants, project membership and object/assignment access. A common secret holder can impersonate any linked agent; use separate tokens for independent providers.

get.description: Required scope: agent:profile. Also requires active owner grant, project membership and assignment (except profile). No task workflow/approval changes.

200.description: Success; no-store. Replayed writes include Idempotency-Replayed: true.

ClaimedAgentId.name: X-ProjectBrief-Agent-ID
ClaimedAgentId.description: Required on every request authenticated by a shared agent credential; must identify an active same-workspace agent linked to that credential. The common Bearer secret grants the ability to claim any linked agent. Legacy individual credentials can omit this header; if supplied it must match their fixed identity.
